articles.title: Newmark Sees Double-Digit Growth in Q3 Despite Capital Markets Dip
articles.narrative: Newmark reported robust financial results for the third quarter of 2026, achieving double-digit year-over-year growth in total revenue and setting the stage for its best full-year performance in company history. The firm's management services and leasing segments were key drivers of this growth, with leasing revenue notably boosted by demand from AI, data center, and technology sectors. Despite a dip in capital markets revenue due to macroeconomic factors like high interest rates, CEO Barry Gosin expressed confidence in the firm's long-term growth strategy, emphasizing continued investment, global expansion, and the strength of its brand as he prepares to transition to chairman.

articles.title: Remembering RXR’s Lauren Maturo, Who Passed Away at Age 32
articles.narrative: Lauren Maturo, Vice President of Marketing at RXR and daughter of RXR President Mike Maturo, passed away at age 32 in a car accident on October 24. Colleagues and industry leaders remembered her as a bright, authentic, and inspiring individual who championed women in real estate and brought creativity and warmth to her work and relationships. She was deeply involved in RXR's marketing efforts, mentored younger professionals, and was pursuing a master's degree at NYU's Schack Institute of Real Estate.

articles.title: Day Care Operator Inks 21K-SF Lease in Brooklyn’s Gravesend

The new day care center, which will accommodate 300 children, is expected to open in the second quarter of 2027. Brokers noted that securing a tenant for a space of this size with specialized requirements presented challenges, but a collaborative approach helped finalize the deal.

articles.title: Partners Development Breaks Ground on 80,000 SF Industrial Project in Seguin, Texas
articles.narrative: Partners Development, an affiliate of Partners Real Estate, has commenced construction on the first phase of Seguin Commerce Park, an 80,000-square-foot industrial project in Seguin, Texas. This initial phase will consist of two 40,000-square-foot buildings, with construction financing provided by Palladius Capital Management. The project is expected to be delivered in late spring/early summer 2027, and the buildings are being marketed for lease or sale. The overall development is planned to include eight buildings totaling 234,600 square feet.

articles.title: StreetLevel Investments Welcomes New Tenants to Mixed-Use Development in Forney, Texas
articles.narrative: StreetLevel Investments has announced a new wave of tenants for its Village at Gateway mixed-use development in Forney, Texas. The 152-acre project, located east of Dallas, is expanding its retail and entertainment offerings with several new operators. The development is also slated to include future multifamily units, a significant medical district, and additional retail square footage, indicating a comprehensive long-term vision for the site.

data_points.notable_features: Mixed-use development located approximately 20 miles east of Dallas, with future plans for multifamily units, a 50-acre medical district, and additional retail space.

articles.title: HRSS CPAs Signs 19,569 SF Office Lease in Houston’s Westchase District

articles.title: PCCP Provides $130M Construction Loan for Newark Multifamily Project
articles.narrative: PCCP LLC has provided a $130 million senior construction loan for the second phase of the Ballantine multifamily project in Newark, NJ. This phase will feature a seven-story building with 501 residential units, including 101 affordable housing units, and a 57,500-square-foot grocery store. The joint venture developing the project anticipates completion in late 2028.

data_points.notable_features: Includes 101 affordable housing units and a 57,500-square-foot grocery store.

articles.title: Pinecroft Realty acquires 40,268-square-foot medical office building in Bryan
articles.narrative: Pinecroft Realty has acquired the Brazos Valley Medical Office Building, a 40,268-square-foot, 100% leased medical office property in Bryan, Texas, from a local investor. The two-story building, developed in 2015, is strategically located near popular neighborhoods, hospitals, and shopping, and is part of the Physicians Centre Hospital campus. This acquisition aligns with Pinecroft's strategy of partnering with local physicians and expands its presence in the growing Bryan market.

articles.title: Pre-leasing starts at M&R Development’s Bluffs on Lake in St. Francis

The project includes 8,000 square feet of ground-floor retail and a comprehensive suite of amenities, emphasizing wellness, remote work facilities, and direct access to the Oak Leaf Trail.

articles.title: Plenty of positive signs for North American big-box industrial market
articles.narrative: The North American big-box industrial market is demonstrating renewed vitality, with significant increases in leasing activity and net absorption during the first half of 2026. This surge in demand has led to a notable drop in vacancy rates, particularly for larger facilities, indicating a healthier market balance after a period of oversupply. Developers are responding with a more selective approach to new construction, focusing on build-to-suit projects and markets with tightening vacancy and strong tenant demand, while average rental rates are also on the rise.
articles.market_intelligence: New leasing activity in North America reached 170.6 million square feet during the first half of 2026, a 17% increase from the second half of 2025. Net absorption climbed to 87.6 million square feet, more than double the level recorded a year earlier. Big-box vacancy fell to 9.4% from 11.1% a year earlier, with buildings over 750,000 square feet seeing a 7.1% vacancy rate. Construction pipeline increased to 142.6 million square feet from 113.1 million square feet at the end of last year. Average taking rents for big-box properties reached $8.87 per square foot on a triple-net basis, up 3.9% year over year. Chicago's big-box vacancy rate was 8.7% at midyear 2026, with 13.6 million square feet of new leasing and 4.2 million square feet of net absorption. Dallas-Fort Worth led all markets in new leasing during the first half with 26 million square feet.

articles.title: Evelyn Capital Pays Discounted Price for Franklin Office Building
articles.narrative: Evelyn Capital acquired Two Greenway Centre, a 156,000-square-foot office building in Franklin, TN, for $31 million from TA Realty. This transaction represents a significant discount from its previous sale price of $43.5 million in 2019. The acquisition continues Evelyn Capital's strategy of purchasing office assets at reduced prices, following their 2024 acquisition of Philips Plaza in downtown Nashville.

articles.title: Cohen Brothers Ink $400M Loan for 23-Story West Palm Beach Office Tower
articles.narrative: Cohen Brothers Realty Corp. has secured a $400 million loan for the development of West Palm Point, a 23-story Class AA+ office tower currently under construction in West Palm Beach. The project, which will feature 438,000 square feet of office space, ground-floor retail, and extensive amenities, is expected to be delivered in the first quarter of 2029. The financing was arranged by Cooper Horowitz.

data_points.notable_features: Class AA+ office tower with ground-floor retail, a 30-foot-tall lobby, 1,200-space parking structure, one-acre private landscaped rooftop park with putting green, dog park, café, water feature, fitness center, and conference center. Located near the Palm Beach County Convention Center.

articles.title: Urban Edge Pays $90.3M for 140K-SF Boca Raton Retail Center
articles.narrative: Urban Edge Properties has acquired Regency Court, a 140,000-square-foot grocery-anchored shopping center in Boca Raton, Florida, from Invesco for $90.3 million. The acquisition was underwritten with a focus on future rent growth, as the anchor tenants currently pay below-market rents with leases expiring in six years. Urban Edge anticipates an 8% to 9% unlevered internal rate of return from the asset, which benefits from its prime location with no competing grocery-anchored centers nearby and high annual visitor traffic.

data_points.notable_features: Grocery-anchored shopping center with no other grocery-anchored center within 2 miles.
data_points.project_notes: Acquisition underwritten based on rent-growth opportunities rather than initial yield.

articles.market_intelligence: The property attracts 3.3 million visitors annually, with traffic continuing to rise.

articles.title: Gilbane-Led Team Breaks Ground on 200-Unit Raleigh Affordable Housing Project
articles.narrative: A development team led by Gilbane, Harmony Housing Affordable Development Inc., and F7 International Development has broken ground on Chapanoke, a 200-unit affordable housing community in Raleigh, NC. The nearly $58 million project, located at 326 Chapanoke Road, will also feature 10,000 square feet of retail space. The development is designed to serve households earning between 30% and 70% of the Area Median Income and is expected to be completed in early 2028.

data_points.notable_features: Will include 66 one-bedroom, 86 two-bedroom, and 48 three-bedroom apartments.
data_points.project_notes: The development will serve households earning between 30% and 70% of Area Median Income (AMI). Wake County and the City of Raleigh are contributing subordinate public financing, including $7.1 million in gap financing from Wake County.

articles.financing: Public-private financing structure including Low-Income Housing Tax Credit equity, private construction and permanent financing, and subordinate public financing from Wake County and the City of Raleigh.

articles.title: 140-Acre Attleboro Golf Course Hits Market, Pitched For Redevelopment
articles.narrative: The 140-acre Stone-E-Lea golf course in Attleboro, MA, has been put up for sale by its owner. The property is being marketed as a significant redevelopment opportunity, suggesting potential for new commercial or residential projects on the expansive site.

articles.title: Georgia's Utility Board Race Could Reshape Nearly 20 GW Pipeline Of Data Centers
articles.narrative: The upcoming 2026 midterm elections in Georgia have the potential to significantly alter the state's energy oversight board, which could in turn affect the costs and rates for data centers. The outcome of this race is particularly important given the nearly 20 GW pipeline of data center development in the state, suggesting that changes in energy policy could have a substantial impact on the industry's growth and operational expenses.

articles.title: Meet Bisnow's 2026 New York Power Women Honorees
articles.narrative: Bisnow has announced its 2026 New York Power Women honorees, recognizing leading female executives in the commercial real estate industry. The list includes prominent figures from major firms such as CBRE, JLL, JPMorgan Chase, and KPF, highlighting their significant contributions and influence within the New York market.

articles.title: How Microsoft, Coca-Cola And Amazon Are Adapting Their Offices For AI Age
articles.narrative: This article explores how major corporations like Microsoft, Coca-Cola, and Amazon are re-evaluating their office spaces to adapt to the age of artificial intelligence. The focus is on how AI is influencing workspace efficiency and design, prompting companies to consider new strategies for optimizing their physical environments to support AI-driven workflows and collaboration.

articles.title: Affordable Housing Giant Starts $180M Philly Push: The Philadelphia Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Standard Communities has acquired Helston Apartments for $29.3 million, marking its initial entry into the Philadelphia market. The affordable housing developer has committed an additional $150 million for further acquisitions in the area, signaling a significant expansion strategy. This acquisition underscores the firm's focus on expanding its affordable housing portfolio in key urban markets.
